# CONFORMANCE FIXTURES: color (spec 6.3). Color is display vocabulary end to end;
# the channel accessors are the sanctioned wire bridge.

== a color literal
expr #ff0000
want color #ff0000

== a color literal with alpha
expr #ff000080
want color #ff000080

== a short color literal
expr #f00
want color #ff0000

== rgb takes fractional channels
expr rgb(1, 0, 0)
want color #ff0000

== rgb with alpha
expr rgb(0, 1, 0, 0.5)
want color #00ff0080

== rgb clamps its channels
expr rgb(2, -1, 0.5)
want color #ff0080

== hsv red
expr hsv(0, 1, 1)
want color #ff0000

== hsv green
expr hsv(120, 1, 1)
want color #00ff00

== hsv blue with alpha
expr hsv(240, 1, 1, 0.5)
want color #0000ff80

== color parses text
expr color("#8040ff")
want color #8040ff

== color of unparseable text is unknown
expr color("red-ish")
want nil

== scaling darkens with alpha kept
expr #808080 * 0.5
want color #404040

== scaling brightens and clamps
expr #808080 * 2
want color #ffffff

== dividing scales down
expr #808080 / 2
want color #404040

== the number may lead a scale
expr 0.5 * #808080
want color #404040

== channel r reads 0 to 255
expr #ff0000.r
want num 255

== channel g
expr #80ff00.g
want num 255

== channel b
expr #0000ff.b
want num 255

== channel a reads 0 to 1
expr #ff000080.a
want num 0.501960784

== alpha stamps a new alpha
expr #ff0000.alpha(0.5)
want color #ff000080

== mix meets in the middle
expr #000000.mix(#ffffff, 0.5)
want color #808080

== mix clamps its fraction
expr #000000.mix(#ffffff, 2)
want color #ffffff

== invert flips the channels and keeps alpha
expr #ff000080.invert()
want color #00ffff80

== invert as a builtin
expr invert(#ffffff)
want color #000000

== grayscale black
expr grayscale(0)
want color #000000

== grayscale white
expr grayscale(1)
want color #ffffff

== the accessors are the wire bridge
tier wire
env tint: color = #ff8040
expr tint.r
want num 255

# a bare color VALUE is not tier-gated: the destination's expected shape refuses it,
# not the language — only color WORK (the constructors, the arithmetic) is display-only
== a color literal itself compiles on the wire
tier wire
expr #ff0000
want color #ff0000

== rgb is refused on the wire
tier wire
expr rgb(1, 0, 0)
error display vocabulary

== color scaling is refused on the wire
tier wire
env tint: color = #ff0000
expr tint * 0.5
error display vocabulary

== mix is refused on the wire
tier wire
env tint: color = #ff0000
expr tint.mix(#fff, 0.5)
error display vocabulary
